difficulty_reason: The construction realizes every finite behavioral-distance approximation by an actual rational proof tree. It restricts Kantorovich-style nonexpansive optimization to finite transition supports, uses rational linear-program optima to select witnesses, and recursively builds all needed expectation-rule premises before passing to the least-fixed-point approximation limit. The complete finite-support and witness construction remains in the task; the final limit sentence is not treated as the entire proof. This non-routine quantitative-proof construction supports H2 as one approximate-completeness result.
